name: barbell reverse grip bench press
description: Bench press with an underhand grip. It shifts more load to the upper chest and also works the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar with palms facing you, about shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet down and shoulder blades pinched.
